writing.exampleCaption: The crab is one char but several UTF-8 bytes.
writing.explanation: Single quotes create a char and double quotes create string text. A visible character can occupy several UTF-8 bytes, so text length is not automatically the number of symbols a person sees. Use chars() when you need Unicode scalar values and bytes() when the encoding bytes themselves are the subject.
writing.feedback: Use text.chars().count() when Unicode scalar values are the unit you need.
